title: Burmese Refugees in Thailand Face Fresh Deportation Threat
author: Alex Howlett
text:
Nway, a Burmese political activist who fled Myanmar to avoid forcible conscription into the military, sits for an interview in Chiang Mai, Thailand, September 2026.
Credit: Alex Howlett
In April of 2026, 23-year-old Nway became scared of the dark for the first time in her life. She would lie awake at night, jumping at the noise of a car engine humming past the house she shared with her single mother, anxious that she could be dragged from her bed as she slept.Her fear of the dark was not unfounded. As a Burmese political activist who had spent the last four years of her life in prison until April of this year, she was a high-profile target for forced conscription into the Myanmar military, which seized power in a coup in 2021. The military, which now fully controls only around 20 percent of the country’s territory, has conscripted over 30,000 young people since February 2024 in a bid to strengthen their struggling forces.[...]
